name: tdpilot
description: TDPilot for Codex: local-first TouchDesigner control with 114 tools, truthful pattern/concept routing, deterministic visual techniques, complete intent coverage, transactional execution, live validation, and bounded repair.

interface.shortDescription: Practical, validated TouchDesigner MCP control for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Codex-facing TDPilot wrapper with dual-route practical intelligence: exact validated patterns use deterministic planning, artistic and multi-domain concepts use grounded host authoring and proposal review, and accepted BrainPlans execute transactionally with validation and rollback. Includes the 656-card reviewed operator atlas and stays local-first.
defaultPrompt: Explore the relevant TouchDesigner scope with tdpilot-brain-explorer before mutation.
Route an exact validated TouchDesigner pattern through td_brain_plan, then check complete intent coverage.
Route this artistic or multi-domain concept through td_brain_ground, author, and td_brain_propose.
Execute only an accepted BrainPlan transactionally and validate its actual graph, runtime, and visual behavior.
Recover this TDPilot network from the last failed transaction.
